context: Tests whether the agent correctly uses the DLD dld-decide workflow: running next-id.sh before creating a decision, using printf with \n for newlines and %% to escape percent signs, updating the status of superseded decisions while leaving amended decisions untouched, and regenerating the index afterwards.

checklist.name: New decision file created
checklist.description: A new decision file DL-003.md exists in decisions/records/

checklist.name: Percent signs render literally
checklist.description: The new decision record's body contains the literal strings '100%' and '90%' rendered correctly. Unescaped '%' in a printf format string mangles or drops surrounding text, so intact percentages are the observable evidence that %% escaping was applied.

checklist.name: DL-001 superseded status
checklist.description: The status field in decisions/records/DL-001.md is 'superseded'

checklist.name: DL-002 status unchanged
checklist.description: The status field in decisions/records/DL-002.md remains 'accepted' (not changed to superseded or any other value)

checklist.name: INDEX.md updated
checklist.description: decisions/INDEX.md contains a row for DL-003 and shows DL-001 with status 'superseded'

checklist.name: New decision amends DL-002
checklist.description: The new decision's YAML frontmatter has an 'amends' field containing DL-002, recording the amendment relationship without changing DL-002's own status.

checklist.name: New decision supersedes DL-001
checklist.description: The new decision's YAML frontmatter has a 'supersedes' field containing DL-001.

checklist.name: Required body content present
checklist.description: The body states that Redis will handle 100% of API response caching and that cache hit rates should exceed 90% under normal load.
